artefacts.note: The role-word guard vocabulary: the normalized role nouns the payload's role_word_rules_from_profile declaration prose names, carried as pack DATA — the set was previously a literal in core proposer code. Consumed through pipeline.profile_config.pack_role_words and frozen into resolved configs under the role_words key; guard behavior is byte-identical to the core-literal era (the golden tests). Not a prompt surface.

contents_index.corpus_scope: registry_namespace cuad; cross-corpus links reviewed_edges_only (payload corpus_scope). CUAD contracts are per-agreement worlds: defined terms and role nouns bind inside one document (profile rules DR-08/DR-09).
contents_index.label_categories: The 41 CUAD clause categories carried as slot labels (payload label_categories) — this family's extraction inventory: Parties, the date categories (Agreement Date / Effective Date / Expiration Date), Governing Law, license grants and their restrictions, liability caps (Cap On Liability / Uncapped Liability), termination (Termination For Convenience, Notice Period To Terminate Renewal), Non-Compete / No-Solicit, and the rest of the CUAD v1 label set. Slot channel, not a relation inventory: the family extracts a clause value per category; category-to-task mappings are recorded as profile decision points DR-24..DR-30.
contents_index.metadata_declarations: Per-run parameter declarations mirrored in the payload (triple_threshold 0.25, review_band 0.25-0.50, er_threshold 0.40, embed_model, chunk_window_chars 1000 / chunk_min_chars 100, route_baseline arm_c, er_auto_merge form_variants_only, er_alias_sources text_attested_only, batch_cost_cap_usd 10.0, provider_sort throughput). Declarations, not live values — BatchConfig governs the run (docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §3).
contents_index.redaction_markers: Two observed redaction marker patterns declared in the payload (redaction_markers_observed, measured SC-03/SC-04) so redacted spans normalize instead of extracting as values; the wider style list is convention note CN-2.
contents_index.role_word_rules: Role nouns (Company, Consultant, Employer, Executive, Service Provider, Service Recipient, Party, Parties, Party A/B, Affiliate) are not identities: they resolve to their defining named entities within each document (payload role_word_rules_from_profile; profile rule DR-08). Alias chains defining several labels for one party unify to a single canonical node per document (DR-09).

convention_notes.note: The derived master_clauses.csv is not a source of truth and may carry propagation errors from the span gold — audit before trusting its values (profile decision point, DR-04: 85.87% of non-empty cells are yes/no flags; 7 answer columns carry real values).

Redactions and placeholders appear in multiple styles ('[*****]', '[*]', '***', '[•]', '[address removed]') and normalize to a single redaction token rather than extracting as values (profile trap DR-16; the two regex-observed styles are declared in the payload).

SEC-source boilerplate ('Source: [COMPANY], [FILING], [DATE]' lines) and repeated exhibit headers are stripped before span alignment (profile trap DR-17; exhibit headers appear in 396 of 510 documents, DR-06).

One gold title never matches its file even after whitespace/case normalization — an encoding artifact ('LECLANCHÉ S.A.' in gold vs 'LECLANCH#U00c9 S.A.' as the filename); title-to-file joins on this corpus carry that known defect (profile DR-05 / SC-11).
